patterns.comment: Concept: a type / class, the structural backbone. A quote ends the name, but an apostrophe inside a word is a letter of it — 'Aristotle's Ethics' is one name, so a ' followed by a letter is consumed rather than closing the run
patterns.name: entity.name.type.concept.aot

patterns.comment: value: the data after a colon
patterns.name: string.unquoted.value.aot

patterns.comment: literal: verbatim / raw text in backticks
patterns.name: markup.inline.raw.literal.aot

patterns.comment: table separator: the '|---+---|' rule that marks the row above as the table's header — every symbol is chrome, one quiet colour. Punctuation, not comment: comment scopes render italic in most themes, and an italic pipe tilts
patterns.name: punctuation.definition.table.aot

patterns.comment: table row: the pipes (and any stray dashes/crosses) share the separator's quiet chrome colour so all table symbols read alike, upright; cell text falls to cell-safe shapes and the extension's semantic tokens overlay the parsed truth (attribute / Example / value / formula)
